questions.q: five-question set on the portal: sound and EM wave calculations with prefixes and echoes.
questions.a: Mark scheme on the sheet; e.g. 512 Hz at 340 m/s gives λ = 0.66 m; echo after 1.2 s at 340 m/s gives 204 m
questions.model: Teacher does question 1 on screen: convert, write the equation, substitute, answer with unit.

questions.q: A clap echo from a wall 85 m away returns after 0.5 s. Calculate the speed of sound.
Why do sound and light both obey v = fλ although one is longitudinal and one transverse?
questions.a: The equation follows from the definition of a wave (one wavelength passes per period) for any wave.

questions.q: A radio station broadcasts at 200 kHz with wavelength 1500 m. Show the speed is 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s.
questions.model: Convert 200 kHz to 200 000 Hz. Multiply by 1500: 300 000 000 = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s.

questions.q: Thunder heard 3 s after lightning; sound 340 m/s. Distance?
